item.title: Not every opal shows play-of-color
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Gemologists distinguish precious opal, which has play-of-color, from common opal, which generally lacks it. Both are opal materials.
EXIMUTC view: Describe the actual optical effect before assigning a price or quality category.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/opal-quality-factor
